name: AT&T EasyLink Services Australia
summary: B2B e-commerce/EDI + data/voice services provider, formerly owned by a consortium of AT&T, Qantas and CSC (Computer Sciences Corporation); acquired by AAPT Aug 1999, rebranded AAPT@commerce and integrated with AAPT's connect.com.au ISP.

events.details: Formerly owned by a consortium of AT&T, Qantas and CSC (Computer Sciences Corporation); provided business-to-business e-commerce/EDI plus data and voice telephony services. Exact founding date not established.
